creds=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
fs_pass=[c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
fs_user='susanmiller@gmail.com'
login_res=apis.file_system.login(username=fs_user, password=fs_pass)
access_token=login_res['access_token']

# list files
files=apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path='~/photographs/vacations/', recursive=False, entry_type='files', access_token=access_token)
print('num_files', len(files))

now_year=datetime.now().year
print('current_year', now_year)

# fetch created_at for each file
meta=[]
for fp in files:
    f=apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=fp, access_token=access_token)
    created=f['created_at']
    # parse
    created_dt=datetime.fromisoformat(created.replace('Z','+00:00')) if isinstance(created,str) else created
    month=created_dt.month
    year=created_dt.year
    meta.append({'file_path':fp,'name':fp.split('/')[-1],'created_at':created,'year':year,'month':month})

# summarize months by rule
counts={'Athens':0,'Seoul':0,'Paris':0}
for m in meta:
    if m['year']==now_year and m['month']==1:
        counts['Athens']+=1
    elif m['year']==now_year and m['month']==4:
        counts['Seoul']+=1
    else:
        counts['Paris']+=1
print('counts_by_destination', counts)

# print a sample of each destination
for dest in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']:
    sample=[m for m in meta if ((m['year']==now_year and m['month']==1) if dest=='Athens' else (m['year']==now_year and m['month']==4) if dest=='Seoul' else not (m['year']==now_year and m['month'] in [1,4]))]
    print(dest,'sample',[(x['name'],x['created_at']) for x in sample[:3]])

# also show sorted list of created dates for verification
sorted_meta=sorted(meta, key=lambda x:(x['year'],x['month'],x['name']))
print('first10_sorted_by_date', [(x['name'],x['created_at']) for x in sorted_meta[:10]])
print('last10_sorted_by_date', [(x['name'],x['created_at']) for x in sorted_meta[-10:]])

from datetime import datetime

# Login to file_system
creds=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
fs_pass=[c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
fs_user='susanmiller@gmail.com'
access_token=apis.file_system.login(username=fs_user, password=fs_pass)['access_token']

base_dir='~/photographs/vacations/'

# Ensure subdirectories exist
subdirs=['Athens','Seoul','Paris']
for sd in subdirs:
    dest_dir=f"{base_dir}{sd}/"
    exists=apis.file_system.directory_exists(directory_path=dest_dir, access_token=access_token)
    if not exists.get('exists',False):
        apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=dest_dir, recursive=True, allow_if_exists=True, access_token=access_token)

# List direct files in base_dir
files=apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path=base_dir, recursive=False, entry_type='files', access_token=access_token)

now=datetime.now()
current_year=now.year

# Categorize based on created_at month/year
by_dest={'Athens':[], 'Seoul':[], 'Paris':[]}
for fp in files:
    fmeta=apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=fp, access_token=access_token)
    created=fmeta['created_at']
    created_dt=datetime.fromisoformat(created.replace('Z','+00:00')) if isinstance(created,str) else created
    m=created_dt.month; y=created_dt.year
    if y==current_year and m==1:
        by_dest['Athens'].append(fp)
    elif y==current_year and m==4:
        by_dest['Seoul'].append(fp)
    else:
        by_dest['Paris'].append(fp)

print('current_year', current_year)
print('counts', {k:len(v) for k,v in by_dest.items()})

# Move files
results=[]
for dest, fpaths in by_dest.items():
    for src in fpaths:
        filename=src.split('/')[-1]
        dst=f"{base_dir}{dest}/{filename}"
        # avoid overwriting; if destination exists, don't overwrite
        if apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=dst, access_token=access_token).get('exists',False):
            results.append((src,dst,'skip_exists'))
            continue
        try:
            r=apis.file_system.move_file(source_file_path=src, destination_file_path=dst, access_token=access_token, overwrite=False, retain_dates=True)
            results.append((src,dst,'moved'))
        except Exception as e:
            results.append((src,dst,'fail', str(e)))

moved=sum(1 for x in results if x[2]=='moved')
skip=sum(1 for x in results if x[2]=='skip_exists')
fail=sum(1 for x in results if x[2]=='fail')
print('move_summary', {'moved':moved,'skip_exists':skip,'fail':fail})
print('fails_sample', [t for t in results if t[2]=='fail'][:3])
print('skips_sample', [t for t in results if t[2]=='skip_exists'][:3])

# Post-move verification: count files in each folder and base
base_files=apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path=base_dir, recursive=False, entry_type='files', access_token=access_token)
print('base_files_remaining', len(base_files))
for dest in subdirs:
    dst_dir=f"{base_dir}{dest}/"
    dir_files=apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path=dst_dir, recursive=False, entry_type='files', access_token=access_token)
    print('files_in', dest, len(dir_files), 'sample', [p.split('/')[-1] for p in dir_files[:3]])
